items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: we told her what ideas we had about bringing Big Mama and Sippie Wallace and myself together — three generations of the blues.

ctx.x: Tell me about the PBS Special you did with Sippie Wallace.

And Big Mama? That was our concept. And this lady at KPBS came to us and asked if we wanted to do some kind of special or what we wanted to do. She said it would be a half hour. And so we told her what ideas we had about bringing Big Mama and Sippie Wallace and myself together — three generations of the blues. So she worked very hard, and we got this thing going. And it was the rainiest day. We were doing a jam session, still, and we set it up so that Sippie would do the first, a whole show, an hour. This was at…
Tavern. Which is up north in Solana Beach.
